jobs.description:

Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including relevant skills, training, experience, education, and, where applicable, certifications obtained. Market and organizational factors are also considered. Successful candidates may be eligible to receive annual performance bonus compensation.

Benefits Information:
We are proud to offer best-in-class benefits and programs to support employees and their families in living healthy, happy lives. Our pay and benefit plans have been designed to promote employee health in all respects – physical, financial, and developmental. Depending on whether it is a part-time or full-time position, some of the benefits offered may include:

The Manager Corporate Business Development is responsible for supporting strategic growth initiatives through partnerships, strategic investments, innovative commercial opportunities, joint ventures, licensing and acquisitions. This will be a key role supporting the Corporate Business Development team in their evaluation and execution of transactions. The role is responsible for developing and preparing financial models, supporting technology assessment, managing end-to-end due diligence, negotiating transaction agreements and presenting strategic recommendations key leaders and stakeholders. Responsible for research and evaluation of potential deals while also providing organizational support within a team environment. This individual will prepare valuation analysis in Excel and C-Suite level business cases in PowerPoint, support due diligence, and be leveraged in the negotiation process. Ideal candidate brings strong strategic thinking, financial and analytical rigor, and proven experience driving partnerships or executing transactions in healthcare, life sciences, or related sectors.
Work Experience:
- 6 – 8+ years of experience in corporate business development, strategy, investment banking, consulting, or healthcare venture investing

Preferred Work Experience:
- Healthcare industry experience and/or deal experience
- Prior experience in analyzing companies and technology platforms across a wide range of industry subspecialties including lab services, healthcare information technology, and molecular diagnostics / in-vitro diagnostics is preferred

- Research skills and experience using web-based screening tools
- Experience working with different teams and functional areas in a highly “matrixed” corporate organization
- Experience in evaluating emerging technologies by assessing technical feasibility, clinical utility and competitive differentiation

- Demonstrated ability to think strategically, and develop strategic insights about industry drivers, clinical trends and competitive landscape to subsequently develop a corporate business development strategy
- Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint as well as Internet/Web applications
- Deal oriented execution capability - ability to deal with ambiguity
- Must create scenarios of alternative outcomes and make reasonable judgments based on limited and imperfect information
- Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills
- Must possess intellectual integrity and personal trustworthiness to the extent that he/she generates trust among directors from multiple functions
- Excellent persuasive written and oral communication skills
- Strong planning and organization skills
- Ability to manage multiple transactions with multiple parties/business partners
- Ability to interact confidently with all levels of employees including Senior Management
- Team oriented
- Ability to work independently and drive projects to conclusion

Education:

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Continuous Improvement
jobs.description:
This position is a key leader of a regional lean business transformation team, driving an end-to-end analysis of a functional Business Operations & performance measures, identifying opportunities for profitable growth, and driving business transformation leveraging Lean, specifically focused on Continuous Improvement (CI), system thinking, and big data analytics techniques (adopting AI). Additionally, this leadership role requires operational experience in business financials, functions, and demonstrated ability to collaboratively work functions in order to drive change.

This is a Hybrid scheduled position at our Wood Dale Facility in IL. (3 days onsite and 2 days work from home)
Internal Tittle: Senior Manager, Business Transformation

Pay Range: $125,000 - $155,000/ year, 15% Bonus
Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including relevant skills, training, experience, education, and, where applicable, certifications obtained. Market and organizational factors are also considered. Successful candidates may be eligible to receive annual performance bonus compensation.
Benefits Information:
We are proud to offer best-in-class benefits and programs to support employees and their families in living healthy, happy lives. Our pay and benefit plans have been designed to promote employee health in all respects – physical, financial, and developmental. Depending on whether it is a part-time or full-time position, some of the benefits offered may include:
· Medical/Prescription Drugs
· Dental
· Vision
· Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)
· Supplemental Health Plans
· 401(k) Plan – Company match dollar-for-dollar up to 5%
· Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
· Supplemental Life Insurance
· Dependent Life Insurance
· Short- and Long-Term Disability buy-up
· Blueprint for Wellness
· Emotional Well-Being Resources
· Educational Assistance
· Paid time off / Health Time
Required Work Experience:
-  7 – 10 years of direct responsibility of operational ownership of different aspects of a business, and Continuous Improvement experience, in areas of Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality Lab or Healthcare ​
- Minimum of 7 years mastering a variety Lean and Growth-related tools such as: Strategy Deployment, Problem Solving, Daily Management, Standard Work, and VSM/Process Mapping

Preferred Work Experience:
- Deep knowledge and experience applying with lean methodologies
- Excellent time and project management
- Successfully managed multi-million-dollar budget
- Technical Expertise -Possess the technical skills necessary to be credible; must have significant practitioner experience in Growth & Lean tools and processes

Physical and Mental Requirements:
- Demonstrated success leading large, complex, change initiatives (7+ years)
- Previous experience deploying “kaizen culture” across medium-to-large organizations.
- Experience working in the Toyota Production System, Danaher Business System rigorous lean model.
- Demonstrated understanding of continuous improvement, problem solving, process management, and systems thinking.
- Poise and leadership presence when facilitating discussions and leading workshops.
- Experience managing geographically dispersed teams.
- Demonstrated ability to develop strong relationships with others.
- Advanced data analysis skills.
- Financial and Business acumen
- Change Agent
- Working knowledge of Hoshin-Kanri (Policy Deployment) principles and practices.
- Effective written and verbal communication skills across multiple formats:  formal presentations, training material development, meetings, conference calls, e-mails, and memos.
- Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously.

Skills:
- Excellent written and verbal skills, results oriented, and collaborative.
- Highly Preferred - Continuous Improvement certified (LSS Black Belt or Lean certified)

EDUCATION
- Bachelor’s Degree (Required)

LICENSECERTIFICATIONS
Formal training in project management or continuous improvement methodologies (e.g., Six Sigma, Total Quality Management, Lean, Theory of Constraints) (Required)
Lean Certification preferred
- Implement the Lean Business System including standard work, daily management, problem-solving cadence, and kaizen roadmaps.
- Owns the learning, application, and adoption of Lean principles and practices with the goal of building localized self-sufficiency, sustainability, and scalability of improvement efforts.
- Execute strategic lean transformation projects, and the operational execution that results in large-scale improvement across designated functions and businesses.
- Drives cultural change shift from dashboards and analytics towards actions and results.
- Drives the use of big data analytics tools (adopting AI) to tackle system level problems.
- Demonstrated understanding of continuous improvement, process management, or system thinking (value stream thinking).
- Proven track record in facilitating cross functional discussions, targeted workshops and Kaizens to achieve strategic & operational objectives. ​
- General knowledge of Hoshin and breakthrough planning.
- Demonstrates expertise in business transformation projects using program management principles and tools, and has a track record of success leading and influencing at the mid to senior leadership level without direct authority in driving change,
- Captures, quantifies, and reapplies best-in-class practices within a regional function such as laboratories, Logistics or Patient Services.
- Acts as a change agent to guide teams toward success.
- Works with local team members to identify and prioritize continuous improvement opportunities for a regional functional business. Works with functional and site leaders as a “thought leader” to create future state improvement roadmaps with clear executable plans that are in line with the business strategies and improvement needs.
- Contributes toward building a grass-roots culture of continuous improvement, use of big data analytics techniques, system thinking, and cross-functional collaboration.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Business Transformation (Continuous Improvement)
jobs.description:
- This role is responsible for leading Lean Business Transformation by employing Lean Business System standards across an assigned regional area to improve operational performance.
- Drive operational process rigor across end-to-end value streams creating sustainable positive impact across Patient Services, Laboratories, Logistics, and other key functions.
- Develop and directly lead a portfolio of Lean initiatives to improve productivity and costs across operational business processes and sub-processes, and drive increase in revenue.
- Drive the development of a continuous improvement culture by demonstrating and coaching stakeholder teams on Lean Six Sigma principles and toolkit.

This is a Hybrid position.
The incumbent must reside in a commutable distance to one of our offices in Tampa, FL, Tucker, GA, Greensboro, NC and Miramar, FL.
Required Work   Experience:
- 7+ years of cross-functional roles including leadership experience directly applying Lean methodologies.
- Proven knowledge & experience applying Lean methodologies in both production/manufacturing and transactional office environments
- Demonstrated Lean Six Sigma leadership at leading multiple initiatives and Kaizen events to achieve operational results.

Preferred Work Experience:
- Lean expertise working in a mature Lean org: Toyota Production System, Danaher Business System, Shingijutsu Kaizen.
- Experience working in a healthcare organization.
- Successfully led 25+ Kaizen team events of 5-days with proven impact to KPIs.
- Led teams in adopting Daily Management Systems, Model Line implementation, Problem Solving Process(A3)

Physical and Mental Requirements:
- Ability to visit and interact with office and frontline employees at local sites.
- Ability to effectively lead multiple initiatives at the same time.

Skills :
- Ability to diagnose current business processes, then articulate an ideal target condition, using Lean coaching methods.
- Prior successful experience applying continuous flow using principles of Takt time, standard work, and single piece flow.
- Ability to accurately assess business performance from a General Manager perspective and provide insights for improvement.
- Prioritize and self-manage multiple projects.
- Exceptional communication skills with multiple levels of the organization.
- Plan and lead communication planning and change management methods.

Education:
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience. (Required)
- Industrial/Manufacturing Engineering Degree (Preferred)

Licenses and Certifications:
- Lean Six-Sigma Blackbelt certification, Shingijutsu Kaizen or equivalent from Toyota, Danaher, GE (Preferred)

Competencies:
Ability to solve complex business problems with minimal direction, prior laboratory or manufacturing experience, professional presentation skills, broad business management skills.
- Proactively identify Lean initiatives across key end-to-end value streams and clearly define business impact.

- Lead multiple complex Lean initiatives through all stages of charter, program development or problem solving, implementation, and sustainment. Maintain clear initiative documentation across assigned portfolio.

- Demonstrate expertise in application of standard Lean Toolkit (Std Work, DMS, Problem Solving, Kaizen, VSM and more) and effective use of data analysis.

- Engage with senior leadership and stakeholder teams to obtain support and participation in business transformation initiatives.

- Drive cultural transformation by promoting problem solving and empowering employee ownership of their roles in continuous improvement.

- Provide and facilitate effective professional level training on Lean concepts to cohorts of functional stakeholder teams.

- Apply change management strategies to foster successful implementation of standard work.

- Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements as well as internal standards for safety, quality, and environmental sustainability.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager (Remote)
jobs.description:
Healthcare Analytics Solutions (HAS) is an innovative team within Quest Diagnostics that leverages Quest data to develop products and services to improve outcomes in healthcare across many different markets (Pharma, Clinical Trials, Health Plans/Payors, Hospitals/Health Systems, and Public Health agencies).

This role will support the Innovation Architecture and Advanced Analytics (IA3) vertical as a strategic leader responsible for overseeing the entire lifecycle of innovation projects, from ideation to execution, ensuring they align with the organization's strategic goals. The Sr. Program Manager will drive the organization's growth and competitive edge by fostering a culture of innovation and leveraging advanced analytics. Responsibilities will include the managing of a portfolio of interconnected projects, guiding cross-functional teams in developing and prototyping new solutions while also managing the innovation pipeline, budget, and resources. You will act as a bridge between strategic vision and execution, ensuring that innovative ideas and data-driven insights are translated into tangible business value and steering projects toward achieving business goals through the successful delivery of analytics products and innovative solutions.

Key projects you will manage include advanced machine learning/AI development to create a precision healthcare platform for HAS and Quest. To successfully support and drive these initiatives you will partner with IA3 scientists and leadership to manage complex technology programs from concept to deployment.
Required Experience:
•    A minimum of 6–10 years of demonstrated experience leading complex programs and projects from initiation to completion in a technology or data-focused environment.
•    Deep experience with both waterfall and agile methodologies, including specific expertise in SAFe/Scrum frameworks, to guide teams effectively.
•    Proven ability to lead impactful change, facilitate high-stakes discussions and workshops, and influence business leaders and stakeholders at all levels. Must be skilled in developing strong, collaborative relationships across the organization.
•    Demonstrated success partnering with clinical, technical, compliance and commercial teams to deliver complex products
•    Proven ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously and deliver high-quality products within defined timelines.
•    Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.
•    Demonstrated data analysis skills with some experience in continuous improvement and process management to drive data-informed decisions.
•    Experience with AI/ML development and deployment.
•    (Preferred) Experience managing innovation architecture programs that include reference architectures, plans of record, dependency maps and risk analyses.

Technical Knowledge
•    Proficiency with Agile/Scrum methodologies and product management tools (e.g., Jira, Aha!, Confluence).
•    Familiarity with product analytics and feedback tools (e.g., Pendo, Amplitude, or similar).
•    Working knowledge of software development processes, APIs, and data workflows.
•    An understanding of cloud environments
•    Knowledge of machine learning project life cycle, including architecture, training, validation and deployment.
•    Comfort with the language of data science, including both scientific and informatics technology domains.

Skills
•    Strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management.
•    Excellent communication and presentation abilities for technical and non-technical audiences.
•    Analytical mindset with focus on data-driven decision making and performance metrics.
•    High attention to detail, organization, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
•    Strategic problem-solver with the ability to influence without authority.
•    Adaptable and proactive in dynamic, fast-paced environments.
•    Ability to coordinate programs of multidisciplinary teams that may include collaborators from outside HAS and outside Quest Diagnostics.

Education
•    Bachelor's degree from accredited college or university in related area of Science, Mathematics, Business, Economics, or Information Technology.
Strategic Alignment & Roadmap Development
•    Act as a strategic partner and chief of staff to business and technology leads, ensuring the 12–18-month IA3 product and platform plans align with long-term enterprise priorities.
•    Develop and maintain the comprehensive IA3 portfolio and program roadmaps, including dependency maps, milestone plans, and critical paths, to guide the evolution of our innovation architecture and analytics capabilities.
•    Facilitate the translation of the high-level IA3 vision into executable, multi-team programs, surfacing strategic trade-offs and opportunity costs to leadership to ensure alignment on the highest-value initiatives.
•    Drive technology alignment and decision-making not only within the IA3 vertical but also across all related business and technology verticals to ensure cohesive strategy and execution.

Program Execution & Delivery Management
•    Champion the organization's operating frameworks (e.g., Stage Gate, Stage Gate Lite) to ensure a seamless idea-to-market execution for all IA3 initiatives, from concept to delivery.
•    Serve as the primary interface between the IA3 team and its partners, managing the intake, clarification, and prioritization of all development requests for dashboards, data science, and innovation architecture.
•    Proactively identify and manage cross-priority dependencies, execution risks, and capacity constraints, driving timely resolution of blockers to maintain momentum.
•    Ensure that shared and dedicated Advanced Analytics capacity is understood and allocated effectively against the highest-value initiatives, protecting platform and infrastructure work from unplanned disruption.

Stakeholder Communication & Accountability
•    Serve as the primary point of accountability for the health and outcomes of the entire IA3 portfolio, including all programs and initiatives within it.
•    Drive alignment and decision-making across a wide array of stakeholders, including Product, Technology, Sales, Marketing, and senior leadership.
•    Assimilate and deliver concise, executive-ready updates on plans, progress, risks, and required decisions at a regular cadence, building trust as a neutral, data-driven integrator.
•    Ensure communication is aligned across all internal IA3 teams and with other technology verticals, guaranteeing that commitments made to leadership and business teams are realistic and achievable.

Technology liaison
•    Work closely with AI/ML science teams as well as business leads to ensure tight integration between product and commercial needs and technology platforms.
•    Act as an AI/ML champion across HAS by helping to coordinate education and training for all HAS members.
•    Coordinate and manage IA3 platform projects that reach beyond HAS by liaising with the broader Quest enterprise stakeholders.

jobs.title: Senior Specialist, Business Intelligence & Analytics
jobs.description:
This position is responsible for leading automation efforts using UiPath , providing technical support of inbound and outbound eligibility feeds, dashboard development, and custom report generation in support of internal and external customer needs. Also provides advanced technical product support for Employer Population Health applications working closely with internal and external customers.
This position is also responsible for gathering business requirements for inbound analytics requests, designing and developing solutions using UiPath (RPA) , Tableau, Power BI, and/or Alteryx, and presenting findings and strategic output to leadership. This position does not directly supervise others but is responsible for driving results across cross-functional teams and coaching junior developers on the best use of models, automated processes, and data standards.
This is a remote opportunity however the incumbent must reside in a commutable distance to one of our Major labs in Kansas (Lenexa Lab), Missouri (St Louis Lab), Colorado (Denver Lab), Ohio (Cincinnati Lab), Indiana (Indianapolis Lab), Illinois (Wood Dale Lab, Schaumburg Lab)

No Sponsorship available.

Pay Range: $80,000 - $100,000/ year, 5% Bonus
Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including relevant skills, training, experience, education, and, where applicable, certifications obtained. Market and organizational factors are also considered. Successful candidates may be eligible to receive annual performance bonus compensation.
Benefits Information:
We are proud to offer best-in-class benefits and programs to support employees and their families in living healthy, happy lives. Our pay and benefit plans have been designed to promote employee health in all respects – physical, financial, and developmental. Depending on whether it is a part-time or full-time position, some of the benefits offered may include:
· Medical/Prescription Drugs
· Dental
· Vision
· Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)
· Supplemental Health Plans
· 401(k) Plan – Company match dollar-for-dollar up to 5%
· Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
· Supplemental Life Insurance
· Dependent Life Insurance
· Short- and Long-Term Disability buy-up
· Blueprint for Wellness
· Emotional Well-Being Resources
· Educational Assistance
· Paid time off / Health Time
Work Experience
- UiPath & Automation:  3+ years of hands-on experience designing, developing, and implementing enterprise-scale Robotic Process Automation (RPA) solutions using UiPath (UiPath Advanced Developer certification is a plus).
- Data & Analytics:  5+ years of progressive, recent Data Science related experience including Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Dashboarding, Data Profiling, and Data Management.
- Data & Analytics:  5+ years of progressive, recent Python experience including Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Dashboarding, Data Profiling, and Data Management.
- BI Visualizations:  Demonstrated strong experience in Power BI or Tableau for high-quality dashboard creation, data profiling, and visual data storytelling.
- Data Querying & ETL:  Proven proficiency in SQL and ETL tools. Experience with Alteryx (1+ years of workflow development) and Snowflake is highly preferred.
- Industry Experience:  1–2 years of experience in the Healthcare, Diagnostics, or Clinical Laboratory industry is preferred.
- Project Management Tools:  Experience with Smartsheet workflow automation, portfolio tracking, and automated communication streams is an asset.
- 2+ years of any Intelligent Automation platform like Power Automate, UiPath/gen AI, etc.
- 2+ years strong demonstrated business intelligence experience including dashboarding in Tableau/Power BI/Looker for dashboard creation and visual data storytelling, data visualization – creating dashboard and giving insights from the data.
- Demonstrated proficiency in SQL and ETL processes

Technical Skills & Competencies
- Expert Proficiency in UiPath:  Expert-level capability in building, deploying, and managing automated bots (Attended, Unattended, and Studio) along with orchestrator experience.
- Advanced Data Analysis:  Strong capability to dissect complex operational datasets (e.g., specimen collection volumes, turnaround times, and onboarding lifecycles) and translate them into actionable business insights.
- Database & SQL Mastery:  Exceptional skill in writing, tuning, and optimizing complex SQL queries and managing data pipelines.
- Visual Storytelling:  Advanced skill in designing intuitive Power BI and Tableau dashboards utilizing best-practice UI/UX principles.
- Workflow Design:  Strong analytical mindset with the ability to map out current-state business workflows and design automated future-state processes.
- Communication & Collaboration:  Excellent communication skills with the ability to convey complex technical architectures and automated workflows to non-technical executive stakeholders.

Education
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, or a related quantitative field. Equivalent work experience will be considered.
- Lead RPA and Automation Initiatives:  Lead the end-to-end design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing support of scalable and sustainable automation solutions using UiPath to streamline business operations and eliminate manual data processing.

- Requirements Gathering:  Independently lead the process of gathering and evaluating complex business requirements for incoming business analytics and workflow automation requests; translate requirements into efficient and effective technical solutions.

- Analytics & Reporting Solutions:  Lead the design, development, deployment, and maintenance of sustainable/automated Business Intelligence (BI), reporting, and analytical dashboards using Tableau and Power BI. Create scorecards, operational workflows, and highly interactive visualizations for regional leadership.

- Database & Query Optimization:  Design, develop, deploy, and support measure algorithms in the form of complex SQL scripts, stored procedures, and database queries (primarily within Snowflake and SQL Server environments).

- Data Hierarchy & Account Management: Support database administration and datasets tracking client onboarding lifecycles, and manage complex parent–child account hierarchies to ensure seamless rolled-up executive reporting.

- Ad-Hoc Business Reporting:  Run and support monthly and ad-hoc client reporting pipelines. Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve issues related to automated data processing and external system integrations.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration:  Partner with national teams, database administrators, and business stakeholders to execute project tasks, implement security protocols (including row-level access controls), and maintain infrastructure stability.

jobs.description:

Reporting to the SVP, Commercial Oncology, this executive partners with commercial colleagues across Advanced Oncology, Health Systems, and Clinical Franchises to understand the complex pathology and oncology needs of large-scale institutions and position Quest’s premier Anatomic, Subspecialty, and Digital Pathology solutions (including AmeriPath and Dermpath Diagnostics).
By building deep, trust-based relationships with C-suite executives, Chief Medical Officers, Pathology department chairs, laboratory administrative leaders, and key oncology stakeholders, this role identifies unmet clinical needs, navigates complex enterprise workflows, negotiates high-value B2B agreements, and oversees seamless solution implementation to maximize Quest share and patient impact.
This is a field-based sales role with weekly travel throughout the North and East regions - this person may reside in NY or NJ.

Required Work Experience:

- Healthcare B2B & Solutions Sales: Minimum of seven to ten (7–10) years of successful enterprise sales, strategic account business development, or high-level account management experience in the healthcare/diagnostics sector with a documented history of quota overachievement.

- Pathology / Oncology Domain Experience: Minimum of four (4) years working in a Pathology, Clinical Diagnostics, or Oncology B2B commercial environment managing complex health systems and matrixed customer organizations.

- Complex Contracting: Proven experience structuring, negotiating, and executing complex enterprise contracts, scopes of work (SOWs), and multi-stakeholder commercial agreements.

Preferred Work Experience:

- Direct commercial experience representing subspecialty pathology laboratory services (e.g., AmeriPath, Dermpath Diagnostics, esoteric reference testing).

- Experience with product launches, market development programs, and consultative methodologies (such as Challenger Sales or IMPAX models).

Knowledge

- Deep understanding of the diagnostic reference laboratory business model, esoteric clinical tests, and pathology workflows.

- Strong working knowledge of healthcare industry economics, payor landscapes, and B2B pricing structures.

- High level of compliance awareness regarding laboratory regulations (e.g., Stark Law, Anti-Kickback Statute).

Core Competencies

- Business Acumen: Understands business operations, market economics, and financial levers to close profitable contracts.

- Customer Focus: Dedicated to meeting and exceeding client expectations; establishes and maintains effective trust.

- Drive for Results: Focuses energy on high-priority targets; can be counted on to consistently exceed sales goals.

- Interpersonal Savvy & Political Savvy: Relates exceptionally well to all kinds of people; can navigate complex organizational hierarchies smoothly.

- Negotiating: Can win concessions without damaging relationships; direct and forceful as well as diplomatic.

- Strategic Planning: Can accurately scope projects, anticipate roadblocks, and marshal resources effectively.

- Presentation Skills: Effective in a variety of presentation settings (one-on-one, group, C-suite), commanding attention and managing group dynamics.

Travel Required (50-75%)

Education:

- Bachelor's Degree: Required in Business, Marketing, or the Life Sciences. (Required)

- Master’s Degree / Advanced Degree: Preferred (MBA, M.S. in Life Sciences, or other relevant advanced clinical/business degree). (Preferred)

Technical Training or Professional Licensing:

- Clinical & Laboratory Acumen: Deep understanding of Anatomic Pathology, Oncology, and cancer diagnostics—including IHC, Flow Cytometry, Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS), Cytogenetics, Germ-line and Somatic genomics, and minimal residual disease (MRD) frameworks.

- Health System & Digital Pathology Workflows: In-depth familiarity with hospital pathology department operations, professional vs. technical billing components, digital slide scanning/AI integration, and health data interoperability (EHR/LIS/HIS).

- Healthcare Economics: Strong working knowledge of diagnostic laboratory reimbursement models, commercial/government payer landscape, hospital margin dynamics, and healthcare policy.

- Regulatory Compliance: Thorough understanding of diagnostic compliance requirements, including HIPAA, the Stark Law, and the Anti-Kickback Statute.

- Valid driver's license required.
New Business Acquisition & Enterprise Strategic Hunting

- Target Major Health Systems & NCCN Accounts: Identify, profile, and secure new, large-scale health system agreements, academic medical centers, NCCN member institutions, and high-volume specialty networks.

- Portfolio Positioning & Value Proposition: Drive strategic adoption of Quest’s comprehensive Anatomic and Advanced Pathology portfolio, positioning AmeriPath, Dermpath Diagnostics, and esoteric testing services as market-leading solutions for subspecialized diagnostic accuracy, clinical quality, and operational efficiency.

- Complex B2B & SOW Proposals: Lead the development of sophisticated, client-centric B2B commercial proposals and Scopes of Work (SOW), presenting clear clinical, operational, and financial value propositions to hospital leadership and executive committees.

- Strategic Corporate Opportunities: Identify and support the evaluation of strategic mergers & acquisitions (M&A) and partnership opportunities complementary to Quest Diagnostics and AmeriPath corporate growth objectives.

Solutions Architecture, Workflow Alignment & Technology Integration

- Advanced Pathology Solutions Delivery: Structure, present, and close complex pathology delivery models tailored to target markets as directed by their VP, including:

- Digital Pathology and Artificial Intelligence (AI) diagnostic enablement tools.

- Technical-only (Tech-only) FISH, Flow Cytometry, and Immunohistochemistry (IHC) / Special Stains services.

- Subspecialized Hematopathology, solid tumor testing, and reference laboratory send-out consolidation.

- Genomic and somatic diagnostic pathways, supporting NGS, cytogenetics, and downstream minimal residual disease (MRD) strategies.

- Clinical & Operational Dialogue: Demonstrate in-depth knowledge of hospital/health system pathology workflows and how pathologists guide oncology diagnoses, therapeutic selection, and multidisciplinary tumor boards. Facilitate high-quality medical and operational dialogue with C-suite leaders, lab directors, and pathologists.

- Informatics & Systems Integration: Collaborate with Information Technology to align client workflows across Hospital Information Systems (HIS), Laboratory Information Systems (LIS), and ambulatory EHRs, driving seamless digital connectivity, compliant order entry, and automated result routing.

Business Planning, Metric Adherence & Matrix Collaboration

- Cross-Functional Synergy: Partner with regional sales leadership, Advanced Oncology commercial teams, Health Systems counterparts, Medical Science Liaisons (MSLs), Lab Operations, and Franchise leads to execute unified market development plans.

- Pipeline & Sales Acumen Metrics: Maintain rigorous sales discipline and pipeline sufficiency in alignment with corporate metrics, including pipeline volume, C-suite/physician meeting productivity, collaborative cross-franchise touchpoints, and closed-won annual contract value (ACV).

- Brand Strategy & Market Insights: Collect and communicate critical field insights, voice-of-customer feedback, competitive intelligence, and regulatory/payer trends back to Commercial Oncology franchise and brand leadership to refine commercial strategy and service design.

Account Retention, Contracting & Onboarding Governance

- Executive Stakeholder Engagement: Maintain sustained, multi-level executive relationships across client institutions (Chief Medical Officers, VP of Oncology, Pathology Chairs, Lab Administrative Directors, and Practice Managers) to protect existing business and foster long-term loyalty.

- Contract Management & Compliance: Lead commercial contract negotiations, strategic renewals, fee adjustments, and price modifications while ensuring strict adherence to healthcare legal/regulatory standards (Stark Law, Anti-Kickback Statute, and corporate compliance).

- Onboarding & Implementation Support: Coordinate with Quest Operations, project managers, and onboarding specialists during implementation to ensure a seamless transition before handing off day-to-day coordination to designated Account Management teams.

- Revenue Protection: Actively monitor account health, order patterns, and send-out utilization to mitigate revenue leakage and proactively address operational bottlenecks.

Pay Range:  $170,000 - $230,000/year + 25% Annual Incentive Plan + Long-Term Incentive

Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including relevant skills, training, experience, education, and, where applicable, certifications obtained. Market and organizational factors are also considered. Successful candidates may be eligible to receive annual performance bonus compensation.

Benefits Information:  We are proud to offer best-in-class benefits and programs to support employees and their families in living healthy, happy lives. Our pay and benefit plans have been designed to promote employee health in all respects – physical, financial, and developmental. Depending on whether it is a part-time or full-time position, some of the benefits offered may include:

- Day 1 Medical, supplemental health, dental & vision for FT employees who work 30+ hours

- Best-in-class well-being programs

- Annual, no-cost health assessment program Blueprint for Wellness®

- healthyMINDS mental health program

- Vacation and Health/Flex Time

- 6 Holidays plus 1 "My Day" off

- FinFit financial coaching and services

- Employee stock purchase plan

- Life and disability insurance, plus buy-up option

- Flexible Spending Accounts

- Annual incentive plans

- Matching gifts program

- Education assistance through MyQuest for Education

- Career advancement opportunities

- …and so much more!
The successful candidate for Senior Corporate Counsel will have the following attributes and/or experiences:

- Minimum of 7 years of relevant experience, including significant experience in mergers and acquisitions/transactions and commercial contracting. Top-tier credentials are required for consideration.

- Must be duly licensed to practice law

- Strong educational background including an undergraduate degree and JD are required; background in a scientific field or fluency in science is preferred

- Requires the ability to lead and influence leaders on areas within subject matter expertise

- Ability to run deals and manage complex, high-stakes projects

- Excellent communication skills

- Strong corporate, commercial or transactional experience

- Corporate M&A experience, including public and private transactions on buyer’s side, commercial transactional experience preferred

- An understanding of how to support the achievement of business objectives while considering the regulatory landscape

- Preference for health care law background

- Preference for BigLaw and/or In-house corporate legal experience

- Strong organizational skills, responsiveness, and ability to juggle competing priorities in a fast-paced environment

- Demonstrated ability to interface effectively with all levels of staff, management and executives

- Occasional travel is required

Personal Competencies

This is a unique opportunity for a motivated, high-quality attorney interested in the dynamic, global healthcare industry and in making a difference lives. To join our high-energy, fast-paced team, the ideal candidate will have:

- Outstanding Judgment

- Expert legal, communication, and negotiation skills

- Strategic Agility

- Business Acumen

- Financial Acumen

- Customer Focus

- Collaboration across teams and navigating within a matrixed environment

- Ability to identify risks and develop mitigation plans

- Curiosity; Lifetime learner

- Interpersonal Savvy

- Perspective
- Supporting and managing all aspects of M&A transactions, including due diligence review and drafting diligence reports, redlining and negotiating agreements typically used in M&A, attending meetings and structuring transactions, advising on post-closing integration, and collaborating with internal subject matter experts and outside deal counsel.

- Providing all legal services necessary to support enterprise-wide growth initiatives for the Business Development function.

- Legal drafting and negotiation support for licensing agreements, collaboration agreements, co-development agreements, research collaboration agreements, supply and laboratory management services agreements, material transfer and specimen collection agreements, and master services agreements.

- Providing strategic legal advice and counsel to internal business clients on matters including new product launches, collaborations, strategic alliances, laboratory operations, general legal needs of internal business divisions, and disputes.

- Developing training for clients and perform training for assigned areas.

jobs.title: Women's Health Business Development Executive
jobs.description:
The Women’s Health Business Development Executive is responsible for selling the Women's Health and Reproductive portfolio solutions and value proposition to multiple buyers in different channels to include the C-Suite with a primary focus on securing new business.  Additionally, this position is responsible for developing and maintaining collaborative relationships with internal Primary Account Owners, Commercial Sales Directors, and Executive Sales Directors.

This is a field-based sales position with regular travel throughout the Southwest Region.
Required Work Experience:

- A minimum of 5 years of demonstrated experience, expertise, and success selling to the IVF and OBGYN call point.

- ​Proven ability to develop relationships with physicians and C-suite that result in successful closure of new business.

- Demonstrated success in implementing and driving key strategies and tactics that win new business.

- Demonstrated success in highly complex and technical selling environments.

- Expertise in WHR portfolio, tools, resources, pilots, physician office workflow and physician behavior.

- Hunter mentality a must!

Knowledge:

- In-depth knowledge of Women’s Health diagnostic and reproductive biology, including prenatal care, infectious disease, gynecology, and fertility.

Skills:

- Excellent presentation, communication, and complex clinical selling skills.

- Understand, or be able to quickly attain an understanding of the business needs of customers.

- Proven ability to develop effective closing relationships with key physicians, c-suite, administrators and business staff ​.

- ​Ability to influence individuals toward product differentiated selling without a direct line authority.

- Ability to work independently and to influence deals while leveraging a complex lab operations and commercial teams.

- Actions driven by sound strategic thinking

- Organized self-starter with a focus on results

- Internal and External selling and negotiating skills

- Organized multi-tasker

Education

- Bachelor’s Degree (Required)

- Master’s Degree (Preferred)

Licenses and Certifications

- Valid driver’s license (Required)
- Work closely with the Commercial Selling and Leadership Teams, SSSD, and Product Directors on developing and implementing strategies that drive new WH & R testing growth within all customer segments.

- Build and maintain a robust pipeline, maintain 80% or greater reach / frequency against WHR Targets and Key Selling / Growth Opportunities.

- Build and maintain a business plan, presented monthly.

- Develop and initiate complimentary strategies and tactics to address competitive activity in collaboration with the SSSD, Primary Account Owner, CSD, ESD and Product Directors.
